audit.scope: quasi-ERC4626 token, Fraxtal mint/redeemer and pricing oracle
audit.limits: Financial modeling excluded; Fraxtal sequencer assumption. Deployed runtime matching to Sourcify establishes interpreted code, not audit-to-current-version parity (including Ethereum v3 signature extensions).

code_facts: Ethereum direct deposit/mint/withdraw/redeem are disabled. totalAssets is supply times administered PPS, not frxUSD held or independent NAV.

Controller 3-of-6 may rewrite stored PPS and future accrual rate with no requirement to preserve or increase previous PPS. maxDistributionPerSecondPerAsset returns a mutable pricing-rate parameter, not a hard 4.69% cap. Monotonic-NAV claim withdrawn.
Controller appoints minters; minter_mint does not prove reserve receipt. Redemption owner can recoverERC20 including the underlying to itself, and changes fee/oracle configuration.
Current principal implementation runtimes match verified sources at research block pins. No exact current deployed version to audit-commit linkage was established.

authority_research.scope: Ethereum/Fraxtal token, proxy/admin, active minters, pricing and documented primary-route roots; limited remote deployment sampling
authority_research.signer_independence: Ethereum upgrade Safe owners all within controller six; Fraxtal upgrade Safe overlaps four. Near-zero independent veto on observed roots.
authority_research.reach: Pricing, unbacked mint authority, proxy replacement and recovery of destination redemption cash are direct balance-affecting paths. No enforced delay observed on these roots; no claim that every remote/auxiliary path is fully measured.
authority_research.timelock_accessor_note: timelockAddress() returns a Safe, not a timelock; naming supplies no reaction window.
